svg.text: BaGetter: fenced package writes across two replicas
Two NuGet server replicas share one PostgreSQL database and one S3 bucket. The agent changes the C# server so that every version write stays consistent
through races, crashes and network cuts.
push, indexing and S3 storage services
package rows, plus write claims with a 3 s
reclaim expired claims, delete unowned objects
database link cut for 4 s: the claim expires
Both replicas then serve the 'winner' bytes, and exactly two objects remain under packages/{id}/3.0.2/.
a writer is cut off after its PUT and comes back late
